_howto: Time & Attendance how-to guides. mode click = the user clicks the real button. optional = skipped when not on screen.

guides.title: Create a shift
guides.blurb: Times, breaks, grace periods, overtime and allowances for a shift.

steps.title: Shift Rules
steps.text: Click Shift Rules.

steps.title: Create Shift
steps.text: Click Create Shift.

steps.title: Name and colour
steps.text: For example Day 07:00-16:00. The colour shows on the roster.

steps.title: Start and end
steps.text: The expected times. Tick Next Day for a night shift that ends after midnight.

steps.title: Special shifts
steps.text: Split: two segments a day. Session: several clock-in/out sessions. Floating: flexible hours. Present Day: snaps to the day worked. Leave them off for an ordinary shift.

steps.title: Minimum hours and forced rates
steps.text: Pay at least a number of hours, or force the day's hours to the overtime or Sunday rate.

steps.title: Automatic breaks
steps.text: Minutes taken off for a break automatically, and a separate break once overtime passes a number of hours.

steps.title: Overtime rule and linked leave
steps.text: Use a custom overtime ruleset for this shift, or link it to a leave type for paid time off.

steps.title: Allowances
steps.text: A night shift allowance (fixed or percentage), or make it a standby shift with its own allowance.

steps.title: Grace periods
steps.text: How many minutes late in or early out are still on time. Tick auto-round to snap clockings within the grace period to the shift times.

steps.title: Thresholds
steps.text: The minutes around the shift's start and end the engine uses when deciding what counts as early arrival or overtime.

steps.title: Break tracking
steps.text: A lunch window with a maximum length, and how many short breaks are allowed and for how long. Going over is a break violation.

steps.title: Save Shift
steps.text: Saves the shift. Give it to people as their default shift in Employee Master, or on the roster.

guides.title: Build a weekly roster
guides.blurb: Set who works which shift each day, fill a week at once, and save.

steps.title: Weekly Roster
steps.text: Click Weekly Roster.

steps.title: 1. Department
steps.text: Choose the department.

steps.title: 2. Start from the defaults
steps.text: Auto-Populate Defaults fills the week from each person's default shift and working days.

steps.title: 3. Adjust
steps.text: Click any day to change that person's shift.

steps.title: Rotating patterns
steps.text: For rotating shifts, use Patterns to repeat them for weeks ahead.

steps.title: 4. Save & Recalculate
steps.text: Saves the week and recalculates those days.

guides.title: Set your overtime rules
guides.blurb: BCEA limits and rates for everyone, and rulesets for groups that differ.

steps.title: Overtime Rules
steps.text: Click Overtime Rules.

steps.title: 1. Earnings threshold
steps.text: The current BCEA annual earnings threshold.

steps.title: 2. Limits
steps.text: Weekly overtime and daily total hours limits.

steps.title: 3. Weekends
steps.text: Saturday as overtime, Sunday at 2.0x.

steps.title: 4. Rates
steps.text: Overtime, Sunday and public holiday multipliers.

steps.title: 5. Save Global Defaults
steps.text: Applies to everyone without their own ruleset.

steps.title: Groups that differ
steps.text: Add Ruleset for a group with other limits or rates, then give it to their employees or shift.

guides.title: Fix and approve a day on the timeline
guides.blurb: Use the Visual Team View to correct clock times, decide on overtime and approve.

steps.title: Team View
steps.text: Click Team View.

steps.title: Visual
steps.text: Click Visual.

steps.title: 1. The day
steps.text: Choose the day to check. Click OT to approve or not approved at the top to see only those people.

steps.title: 2. Fix a clock time
steps.text: Drag a white handle, or double-click it and type the exact time. The change waits in the yellow bar above until you save.

steps.title: 3. Overtime
steps.text: Click the overtime and choose Approve OT or Decline OT.

steps.title: 4. Save changes
steps.text: Saves everything waiting, recalculates the days, then applies the overtime decisions.

steps.title: 5. Approve
steps.text: Approve one person here, or tick several and use Approve times.
